newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mercedes Benz sees $279 mln Mexico sales in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes Benz sees $279 mln Mexico sales in 1997.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz hopes to notch up the equivalent of about $279 million dollars in auto and truck sales in Mexico during 1997, a company director told journalists on Wednesday.
"Last year we sold 250 million marks in Mexican sales, and this year it will be double that, 500 million marks," said Friedrich Koorte, director general of Mercedes Benz-Mexico.
Koorte added the company planned to export to Central America in 1997 a total of 1,000 heavy vehicles woth $100 million.
